EquityComponent.name: Equity Component
EquityComponent.definition: Amount subscribed into equity (not including dividends).

InvestedNetAmount.name: Invested Net Amount
InvestedNetAmount.definition: Net amount of money invested in a specific financial instrument by an investor, expressed in the currency requested by the investor.

Refund.name: Refund
Refund.definition: Return of cash that has been overpaid for a subscription.

SubscriptionInterest.name: Subscription Interest
SubscriptionInterest.definition: Interest received when a subscription amount is paid in advance and then invested by the fund.

TaxEfficientProduct.name: Tax Efficient Product
TaxEfficientProduct.definition: Characteristics of a tax efficient product.
